title: Finite direct image reflects constructibility
statement:
Let $p:Z\to S$ be a
finite morphism of
Noetherian schemes, let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring, and
let $F$ be an etale sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $Z$.
If its direct image $p_*F$ is
constructible, then
$F$ is constructible.

proof.text: Put $G=p_*F$ and $H=p^*G$. Convert constructibility of $G$ to IsConstructibleSheaf using isConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf_iff, apply IsConstructibleSheaf.upperStar, and convert back. This pulls back exactly the original finite constructible stratification and its finite locally constant restrictions.

Let $\varepsilon:H\to F$ be the actual upperStarLowerStarAdjunction counit. The existing finite counit instance of lem-fin-finite-direct-image-counit-epi makes it epimorphic. Its published proof is precisely the finite-fibre stalk projection and exact conservative-stalk argument of the original plan, already for module-valued sheaves.

The kernel inclusion into constructible $H$ has constructible source by isConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf_of_mono_noetherian. Convert its source and target to IsConstructibleSheaf and apply IsConstructibleSheaf.cokernel. Since the counit is epic, Abelian.epiIsCokernelOfKernel identifies $F$ as a cokernel of that kernel inclusion; uniqueness of colimits gives the isomorphism from the chosen cokernel to $F$. Transport constructibility by IsConstructibleSheaf.of_iso and convert back to the original predicate.
